scientific.integrity: The recurrence is transcribed from the defining paper. The four-state modal characteristic polynomial is factored exactly, and the full stability region follows from the complete second-order Jury criterion.
limitations: The theorem covers the printed recurrence, not the algebraically different source-associated implementation.
It does not cover the later complete PID recurrence or derivative filtering and clamping variants.
Only deterministic SPD quadratics and asymptotic linear stability are covered.
Equivalent older control-theoretic state-space calculations remain a residual originality risk.

title: Exact quadratic stability and hidden-momentum factorization of the 2018 PID optimizer
